prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star mockup for a mobile-first wedding invitation webpage, portrait phone canvas
Primary request: Design composition option B for the same luxury digital wedding invitation world. This must unmistakably read as an interactive scrolling mobile website, not a poster. Recompose the invitation as a vertical procession of overlapping trousseau drawers: an oxblood moiré-silk cover is pulled upward by a woven ribbon to reveal a personalized pearl invitation, then the story/gallery, schedule, venue and RSVP appear as staggered paper leaves nested inside the case. The cover uses a dimensional antique-brass seal and blind-embossed botanicals, but the key move is the moving ribbon spine that guides the guest through the page.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed interface; no device mockup, no hands, no environmental background
Subject: demo wedding invitation for AMARA & JULIAN, 18 OCTOBER 2026, guest ELENA MARLOWE, venue The Glasshouse Garden
Style/medium: exceptionally polished web UI comp, heirloom jewelry-case and trousseau album material language, contemporary luxury with tactile depth
Composition/framing: 9:16 portrait; oversized silk ribbon runs vertically off-center, binding stacked invitation leaves; top third shows names and seal, middle shows a paired-portrait oval and countdown with layered paper edges, lower third shows schedule and a tall venue engraving ending in a clear RSVP pull-tab; tiny chapter numbers on the ribbon serve as navigation
Lighting/mood: intimate evening light, rich satin sheen, softly lit paper, cinematic but readable
Color palette: deep oxblood and black cherry dominate, pearl blush paper, muted mauve, antique champagne brass; no terracotta
Materials/textures: woven moiré silk, pressed deckled paper, engraved brass, lacquered edge, fine botanical blind embossing
Text (verbatim): "AMARA & JULIAN" "DEAR ELENA MARLOWE" "18 OCTOBER 2026" "PULL TO BEGIN" "THE GLASSHOUSE GARDEN" "RSVP"
Constraints: mobile web UI; readable hierarchy; one dominant ribbon journey; sections visually connected; interface must look implementable in HTML/CSS; no invented commercial claims
Avoid: generic cream wedding template, rustic florals, rose-gold gradients, glassmorphism, floating rounded cards, bento grid, dashboard layout, device frame, hands, watermark, logo
